IT secretary Atul Anand stated that Tamil Nadu fixed security flaws in ten government websites, and the office should track remaining fixes.
MP Kanimozhi commented on rising crimes, and the office should monitor public safety discussions.
Tamil Nadu recorded high women participation in the Samsung Innovation Campus training, and the office should support youth digital initiatives.
